inputs.name: index_html
inputs.default: nginx is running. Set index_html to serve your own page.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: The port nginx listens on and the firewall opens.

inputs.name: firewall
inputs.description: How to open the port: "auto" uses firewalld or ufw if the host has one, "firewalld" or "ufw" installs and uses that one, "none" leaves the firewall alone.

inputs.name: tls_self_signed
inputs.description: Make a key and a self-signed certificate on each host, and serve the site over HTTPS on tls_port too. For labs and internal services without a CA.

inputs.name: tls_port
inputs.description: The port nginx serves HTTPS on, with tls_self_signed, and the port the firewall opens for it.

inputs.name: tls_names
inputs.description: Names and addresses the certificate is for. The first is its common name. When empty, it's for the host's name in hosts.

inputs.name: tls_days
inputs.description: How long each certificate is valid, from 31 to 3650 days. It's renewed when 30 days are left.
